That is why Rep. Correa has actively fought to enact legislation that will help more people go to college by increasing resources for all students. Congressman Correa promotes educational policies that ensure all students can achieve their full academic potential. Environment To preserve our environment for future generations, Congressman Correa believes it is crucial to examine all possible threats to the environment. He strives for a future where Americans can work towards energy independence without harming the environment. Congressman Correa is working hard to ensure the Environmental Protection Agency adheres to standards that will protect the environment so that our children can have access to clean air and water. Maintaining scientific integrity and using the latest research to protect and conserve our environment, is the only way towards truly protecting the environment. Healthcare Ensuring everyone has access to affordable and quality healthcare is one of Congressman Correa’s top priorities. As a Member of Congress, he opposed the repeal of the Affordable Care Act because it would have left 22 million Americans without healthcare coverage. Congressman Correa has opposed deep cuts to Medicaid and Medicare. He has supported legislation to ensure that community health clinics continued to be funded.

"Families are struggling to afford groceries, gas, or a doctor’s visit. Instead of helping them, Republicans just voted to hand President Trump and Pete Hegseth $1.15 trillion for their ‘Department of War’ – the largest U.S. military budget in history. That’s a lot of money to hand over after cutting healthcare and food assistance earlier this year. This bill is further proof that Republicans' priorities are backwards.”   Print   Email   Share   Tweet Previous Article Next Article

CORREA OPPOSES GOP VOTER SUPPRESSION EFFORTS, AGAIN | U.S. Congressman Lou Correa of California Skip to content Close Home About Biography About the District Committees & Caucuses Issues Federal Funding CA-46 Resource Map Contact Email Me Newsletter Sign-Up News Press Releases In the News Press Kit Grants Newsletter Services Art Contest Congressional Commendation DACA Flag Request Grants Help with a Federal Agency Seniors Veterans Passports & Immigration Tours & Tickets Newsletter Sign-Up Special Projects Students Share Your Story Español Close Modal Search Button MENU Español Home News Press Releases September 01, 2026 CORREA OPPOSES GOP VOTER SUPPRESSION EFFORTS, AGAIN Republicans continue to push voter suppression efforts ahead of the November elections Washington, DC – U.S. Representative Lou Correa (CA-46) released the following statement on his ‘no’ vote on H. Res. 1490, a GOP bill that calls for the enactment of the SAVE America Act, which will suppress millions of voters across the country ahead of the November election. “As I have said time and time again: Non-citizens are already barred from registering and voting in federal elections. Break that law, and you’re looking at jail time or deportation. The only thing the SAVE America Act will do is create barriers for service members and everyday Americans to vote. Under these bills, a driver’s license or a military ID – which is good enough to buy a gun, board a plane, or serve our country – wouldn’t be good enough to register to vote. I won’t vote for any bill that makes it harder for the people who defend this country to exercise their right to vote.”   Print   Email   Share   Tweet Previous Article Next Article

CORREA RELEASES REPORT ON THE TRUMP COST-OF-LIVING CRISIS | U.S. Congressman Lou Correa of California Skip to content Close Home About Biography About the District Committees & Caucuses Issues Federal Funding CA-46 Resource Map Contact Email Me Newsletter Sign-Up News Press Releases In the News Press Kit Grants Newsletter Services Art Contest Congressional Commendation DACA Flag Request Grants Help with a Federal Agency Seniors Veterans Passports & Immigration Tours & Tickets Newsletter Sign-Up Special Projects Students Share Your Story Español Close Modal Search Button MENU Español Home News Press Releases August 24, 2026 CORREA RELEASES REPORT ON THE TRUMP COST-OF-LIVING CRISIS New data shows tariffs, the Iran war, and the "Big Beautiful Bill" are driving up costs for families Santa Ana, CA — U.S. Representative Lou Correa (CA-46) released a report titled The Trump Cost-of-Living Crisis in CA-46: How the Administration Is Making Life More Unaffordable , detailing how President Trump's tariff taxes, his war with Iran, and his so-called "Big Beautiful Bill" are driving up costs and squeezing household budgets for families in CA-46 and nationwide. "Trump promised to lower costs on day one, and instead he's made life more expensive for working families in Orange County,” said Rep. Correa. “Every day I hear from constituents who are struggling to pay for groceries, gas, and health care – and this report shows exactly why." The report finds that CA-46 families are already feeling the economic pressure: Families in California have faced an estimated $4,600 average increase in basic living expenses under Trump, including a $999 average increase in housing costs. Trump's Iran war has cost CA-46 families a combined $97 million — an average of $453 per family . Electricity costs for CA-46 families rose by an average of $296 in 2025. The average CA-46 family now spends $1,160 a month on groceries From April 2025 to March 2026, 52,948 California individuals and households filed for bankruptcy – a 14.9 percent increase over the previous year. CORREA: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION STILL HIDING 3 MILLION EPSTEIN FILES | U.S. Congressman Lou Correa of California Skip to content Close Home About Biography About the District Committees & Caucuses Issues Federal Funding CA-46 Resource Map Contact Email Me Newsletter Sign-Up News Press Releases In the News Press Kit Grants Newsletter Services Art Contest Congressional Commendation DACA Flag Request Grants Help with a Federal Agency Seniors Veterans Passports & Immigration Tours & Tickets Newsletter Sign-Up Special Projects Students Share Your Story Español Close Modal Search Button MENU Español Home News Press Releases September 01, 2026 CORREA: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION STILL HIDING 3 MILLION EPSTEIN FILES Washington, DC – Congressman Lou Correa (CA-46) released the following statement after signing onto Congressman Thomas Massie’s discharge petition to force a vote on Epstein Files Transparency Act II , a follow up bill that would give survivors, state attorneys general, and members of Congress the ability to sue the DOJ through private right of action over its failure to disclose records required under the Epstein Files Transparency Act . “The Epstein Files Transparency Act required the full release of the Epstein files, and was signed into law almost a year ago. Yet the Trump Administration continues to withhold more than 3 million documents from the public, and what it has released is heavily redacted. That is not justice. “I again signed onto another one of Congressman Massie’s petitions because survivors and state attorneys general need the power to take the U.S. Attorney General to court and get answers. We cannot let sexual predators get away with sex crimes, in which many of their victims appear to be young children. We must not let power and money shield sexual predators from justice. The survivors deserve the truth. The public deserves the truth. And every name connected to this network deserves to face scrutiny and accountability.”   Print   Email   Share   Tweet Previous Article Next Article

The Right to Learn Act will establish a federal grant program to help schools maintain safe, stable, and trauma-informed learning environments when immigration enforcement actions disrupt school communities. By establishing a federal grant program, this legislation will: Support students’ well-being and learning stability Equip educational and school staffs Strengthen school-community partnerships Protect students’ privacy and access to education “President Trump promised to go after the worst of the worst, instead during his tenure we’ve seen immigration enforcement at elementary schools, places of learning and refuge for our children,” said Congressman Correa. “This critical legislation will make sure our students have a safe learning environment where they can thrive and become our leaders of tomorrow.” “When immigration enforcement actions disrupt a school community, students, educators, and families all feel the impact. No child should have to learn in fear, and no school should face these challenges without support. Correa. “To address this crisis head on, we must increase access to preventive care so that our brothers and sisters on Main Street have access to the support they need and deserve. This legislation is a necessary step in our fight against type 2 diabetes, and I’m honored to work alongside Rep. De La Cruz to keep our communities healthy.” “Preventive care is essential to helping every Texan live a healthy life. Under Trump, Congressional Republicans have surrendered that power again and again to serve the president instead of the people. This amendment is just the latest example of that. “Congress has repeatedly expanded and shrunk the size of the Supreme Court. There’s no reason to lock in nine justices now except that it works in Republicans’ favor. I’ve never supported packing the Court for political advantage, and I don’t support this further surrender of congressional power.”   Print   Email   Share   Tweet Previous Article Next Article
